europe_now.title: School Shooting in Turkey
europe_now.summary: Eleven people sustained injuries following a shooting incident outside a high school in Turkey. Authorities subsequently captured a teenage suspect in connection with the attack.

sources.headline: Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school

europe_now.title: EU and Philippines Trade Agreement
europe_now.summary: The European Union and the Philippines successfully concluded a substantial trade accord following ongoing negotiations. Officials from both regions finalized the terms of the comprehensive agreement.

sources.headline: EU reaches ‘substantial agreement’ on Philippines trade deal
Einigung über EU-Handelsabkommen mit den Philippinen

top_stories.title: Polish Family Benefits Extension
top_stories.summary: Poland has officially initiated the distribution of financial benefits to same-sex couples who solemnized their marriages abroad. This marks a notable shift in the country's administrative implementation of family policy.

sources.headline: Poland has begun paying benefits to same-sex couples who married abroad

top_stories.title: European Union Sanctions Stagnation
top_stories.summary: Member states within the European Union failed to achieve consensus regarding the removal of existing sanctions on Russian oligarchs. Diplomatic efforts to negotiate a lifting of these restrictive measures stalled during recent discussions.

sources.headline: EU fails to reach deal to lift sanctions on Russian oligarchs
